# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the RED→GREEN→REFACTOR loop across multiple cycles, driven by a planner or Gherkin feature file |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Executes one complete TDD cycle (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR) with GREEN retries and optional learning loop |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python; delegates code generation to WorkerAgent and execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Generates code for each TDD phase (test, implementation, refactor) using LLM prompts and playbook context |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | Determines the next test increment by querying the LLM based on current test/implementation state |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer; sends code pulses to a container and verifies execution integrity |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | ContainerRunner implementation using rootless Podman; manages container lifecycle and test execution |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Manages playbook CRUD, delta updates, semantic deduplication, token budgets, and file-based persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Unified logger for TDD and ML experiments; persists to PostgreSQL with SQLite fallback |
| LLMClient | src/utils/llm_client.py | Unified LLM client supporting multiple providers (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama, etc.) |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcomes, extracts error patterns, root causes, and key insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into actionable playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM generation with bullet retrieval and feedback tracking |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval engine for selecting relevant playbook bullets using embedding similarity and keyword matching |
| AutonomousTDDAgent | src/agents/autonomous_tdd_agent.py | Full autonomous TDD agent that builds features incrementally with ensemble learning and test review |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec objects for TDD cycle input |
| ImportFilter | src/agents/import_filter.py | Validates generated code against forbidden imports and blocked builtins |
| ContextMapBuilder | src/utils/context_map.py | Builds AST-based context maps from source files for code generation guidance |
| TestReviewAgent | src/agents/test_review_agent.py | Reviews test quality before implementation, checking structure, naming, assertions, and edge cases |
| RedundancyPreChecker | src/agents/redundancy_checker.py | Pre-checks proposed tests for redundancy against existing tests before the RED phase |
| TDDFailureRecorder | src/agents/tdd_failure_recorder.py | Records TDD failures and interventions for self-improvement and playbook updates |
| TDDLessonInjector | src/agents/tdd_lesson_injector.py | Injects TDD lessons into agent prompts based on development phase |
| PolyglotTDDRunner | src/agents/polyglot_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates RED→GREEN→REFACTOR across multiple LanguagePods for different languages |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for TypeScript TDD cycles via vitest in Podman |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | Generates TypeScript code for each TDD phase |
| TypeScriptRunner | src/agents/typescript_runner.py | PodmanRunner variant pre-configured for the TypeScript harness image |
| GoStepGenerator | src/agents/go_step_generator.py | Generates Go step definitions for Gherkin scenarios |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent.py | Reverse engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |
| ProjectArchitecture | src/agents/project_aware_tdd.py | Manages cached project architecture information for intelligent file placement |
| CodeReuseDetector | src/agents/project_aware_tdd.py | Detects opportunities for code reuse in the project |
| EnsembleLearner | src/ensemble/learner.py | Orchestrates multiple models learning in parallel with cross-voting and deliberation |
| ConsensusBuilder | src/ensemble/consensus.py | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals using clustering and merging |
| VotingSystem | src/ensemble/voting.py | Applies configurable voting strategies (majority, supermajority, weighted, unanimous, escalating) |
| BulletClusterer | src/playbook/clustering.py | DBSCAN-based clustering for playbook bullets to identify knowledge gaps |
| BulletDeduplicator | src/playbook/deduplication.py | Handles semantic deduplication of bullets using embedding similarity |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks with provenance-aware filtering |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for all code generation activities |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³: Context Graph Retrieve-Rank-Reason pipeline for context-aware bullet retrieval |
| ContextScorer | src/retrieval/context_scorer.py | Scores bullets against request context across temporal, team, tech stack, project, and domain dimensions |
| PlaybookReliabilityAnalyzer | src/reliability/playbook_analyzer.py | Correlates bullet retrieval with first-pass GREEN success rates |
| TDDCycleAnalyzer | src/reliability/tdd_cycle_analyzer.py | Measures first-pass GREEN rate and trend over time |
| SuccessRateCalculator | src/analytics/success_rate_calculator.py | Measures experiment success rates across the system by type, version, and time |
| TokenEfficiencyReporter | src/analytics/token_efficiency.py | Computes token efficiency scores from LanguagePod run data |
| CostQualityAnalyzer | src/analytics/cost_quality_analyzer.py | Analyzes cost-quality tradeoffs for ML model performance data |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates performance metrics from audit trail for agent routing decisions |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best agent based on historical performance and cost-awareness |
| BrokerAdvisor | src/broker/advisor.py | Recommends agents by capability fit using capability registry |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous agent capability tracking and team composition |
| RegressionDetector | src/broker/regression_detector.py | Tracks quality scores by model version and detects regressions |
| ModelAttributionTracker | src/benchmark/model_attribution.py | Tracks OpenRouter model attribution in performance metrics |
| ProductionDataAnalyzer | src/benchmark/production_analyzer.py | Analyzes quality data from experiment_logs for production reports |
| BlindEvaluator | src/benchmark/blind_evaluation.py | Scores outputs without knowing which agent produced them |
| FeedbackCollector | src/broker/feedback.py | Stores human ratings and derives blended/drift scores for evaluation calibration |
| HumanDecisionInterface | src/broker/human_decision.py | Interface for human decision-making in agent assignment |
| ContractArchitect | src/contracts/contract_architect.py | Generates interface contracts from natural language requirements |
| ContractDecomposer | src/contracts/contract_decomposer.py | Breaks user specs into interface contracts |
| ContractOrchestrator | src/contracts/contract_driven.py | Orchestrates contract-driven development with validation |
| ModuleArchitect | src/contracts/module_architect.py | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems |
| ModuleTDDBuilder | src/contracts/module_tdd_builder.py | Builds module implementations using TDD methodology |
| AuditClient | src/audit/client.py | Write-only audit client for ACE agents |
| AuditStore | src/audit/store.py | Append-only audit event store with hash chain integrity |
| AuditDashboard | src/audit/dashboard.py | Dashboard for analyzing audit data with agent performance and cost analysis |
| PlaybookQA | src/playbook/qa.py | Q&A system that answers coding questions using playbook knowledge |
| MarkdownImporter | src/playbook/markdown_importer.py | Imports knowledge from markdown files into playbook bullets |
| PostgresPlaybookAdapter | src/playbook/postgres_adapter.py | PostgreSQL-backed playbook manager maintaining compatibility with PlaybookManager |
| PostgresBulletRetriever | src/playbook/postgres_retriever.py | PostgreSQL-backed retrieval system using pgvector |
| PlaybookRepository | src/storage/repository.py | PostgreSQL repository for playbooks and bullets with pgvector integration |
| ACEMLflowCallback | src/ml/mlflow_callback.py | Callback to capture ACE knowledge during MLflow experiments |
| PostgresACEMLflowCallback | src/ml/postgres_mlflow_callback.py | PostgreSQL-backed MLflow callback for ACE knowledge capture |
| MLflowKnowledgeQuery | src/ml/query_interface.py | Unified interface to query MLflow runs with ACE knowledge context |
| EmbeddingService | src/utils/embedding.py | Local embedding generation using sentence-transformers |
| ImportValidator | src/utils/import_validator.py | Validates and corrects import paths in generated code |
| PlaybookEnforcer | src/utils/playbook_enforcer.py | Enforces playbook rules like high-frequency feedback limits |
| DriftDetector | src/utils/file_lock.py | Detects inadvertent file drift during TDD cycles |
| SessionLog | src/utils/session_log.py | Tracks edits and tests in the current session |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as User
    participant CLI as CLI (main.py)
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant LLM as LLMClient
    participant Orch as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector as Reflector
    participant Curator as Curator

    User->>CLI: run_cycle.py
    CLI->>Runner: run_from_feature(feature_path)
    activate Runner

    loop For each cycle (max 12)
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle_number)
        activate Planner
        Planner->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Planner: TestIncrement
        deactivate Planner
        Planner-->>Runner: spec (PodSpec)

        Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
        activate Cycle

        Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
        activate Pod
        Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
        activate Worker
        Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
        LLM-->>Worker: test_code
        Worker-->>Pod: test_code
        deactivate Worker
        Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file: code})
        activate Orch
        Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
        Container-->>Orch: PhaseResult (passed=False)
        Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        deactivate Orch
        Pod-->>Cycle: red_result
        deactivate Pod

        alt RED aborted (security/policy)
            Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult (success=False)
        else GREEN phase with retries
            loop Up to max_green_attempts
                Cycle->>Pod: run_green(spec with error_feedback)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec, error_output)
                activate Worker
                Worker->>LLM: generate(prompt)
                LLM-->>Worker: impl_code
                Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
                deactivate Worker
                Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
                activate Orch
                Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container-->>Orch: PhaseResult
                Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orch
                Pod-->>Cycle: green_result
                deactivate Pod

                alt GREEN passed or abort
                    break
                else GREEN failed
                    Cycle->>Cycle: set error_feedback = output
                end
            end

            alt GREEN passed
                Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
                activate Pod
                Pod->>Orch: pulse({test_file, impl_file})
                activate Orch
                Orch->>Container: send_pulse(files)
                Container-->>Orch: PhaseResult
                Orch-->>Pod: PhaseResult
                deactivate Orch
                Pod-->>Cycle: refactor_result
                deactivate Pod

                opt Learning loop (if reflector + curator configured)
                    Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
                    activate Reflector
                    Reflector->>LLM: generate(analysis_prompt)
                    LLM-->>Reflector: analysis
                    Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
                    deactivate Reflector

                    Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
                    activate Curator
                    Curator->>LLM: generate(synthesis_prompt)
                    LLM-->>Curator: delta_bullets
                    Curator->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
                    Playbook-->>Curator: added_bullets
                    Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
                    deactivate Curator
                end
            end
        end

        Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
        deactivate Cycle

        Runner->>Runner: check if planner says COMPLETE
        alt Complete
            break
        end
    end

    Runner-->>CLI: IterativeResult
    deactivate Runner
    CLI-->>User: print result summary
```
